proteanTecs and You

Here at proteanTecs, you'll be part of a team that's unlocking deep insights to make electronics more reliable, efficient, and high-quality. We're trusted by industry leaders in data centers, automotive, communications, and consumer devices – we work with the world's largest and most notable companies in tech.

Just like our solutions,
we value what’s inside.

At proteanTecs, the innovation we deliver is only possible because of the culture we have - reliability, efficiency, and excellence.

This is Us

We believe that a great team is built not only through hard work but also through shared experiences and fun moments. 

Hear From Our Team

"I experience a rare combination of trust, freedom, and support. I have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies and make a real impact in their development.  It’s a very collaborative and uplifting culture,  which makes every challenge exciting and rewarding."

Efrat Shachor, Data Engineering & BI Team Leader

"Joining a startup like proteanTecs has provided me with the opportunity to be very hands-on, where I can make a big impact on our solutions, and witness firsthand how what I do shapes our customers' final products. It's been an incredibly rewarding and enriching learning experience."

Itay Politi, Circuit Tech Lead

"We don’t just work side by side, we think together. Every challenge we face becomes a shared mission, where ideas flow, problems get broken down, and smart solutions rise through teamwork."

Matan Balyka, Layout Designer

"I joined proteanTecs and it’s truly one of the best decisions I’ve made. From day one, it felt like home, the people are smart, collaborative, and genuinely supportive. Whether it’s code reviews, brainstorming, or grabbing lunch, the team spirit is real."

Bar Korkos, Software Engineer

"At proteanTecs, we create Intelligence Everywhere with versatile solutions that power the edge. It’s exciting to be part of the team behind the world’s best chip health monitoring accelerator, built for all chips, and built to make a difference."

DH Lee, Sales Korea Country Manager

"Working at proteanTecs gives me the rare opportunity to understand the full silicon lifecycle, opening up a diverse range of technical opportunities and fostering significant professional growth. Each day brings fresh opportunities to learn and tackle exciting customer design challenges." 

Dileep Kumar Reddy, Staff Application Engineer

"One of the things I appreciate about working at proteanTecs is the collaborative environment. My colleagues are always willing to share work projects and explain what they are working on. It's helpful to see how our work contributes to the bigger picture."

Yuval Jacoby, Logic Design Engineer

"It’s truly inspiring to be part of a company that’s delivering breakthrough technology and creating tangible value for customers every day. I’m proud to contribute and excited to see where the journey leads."

Ela Rahamim, Program Manager

Investing in Your Success

We want to see you succeed — which is why we invest in our people with competitive compensation, benefits, professional development, internal mobility, and fun gifts and experiences throughout the year.

Personalized Benefits
Flexible work hours & hybrid work, healthcare coverage, wellness perks, and competitive compensation.
Your Growth
Career & leadership development, mentoring & coaching, and education reimbursement.
Company Equity
Everyone gets shares – our success is your success.
Pet Friendly
Dog-friendly office environment, you're welcome to bring your four-legged friend to the office.
Culture & Events
We celebrate happy hours, birthdays, and company events. Beer & ice-cream on us!
Giving Back
Volunteer Time Off (VTO) for social impact. Support your cause without compromise.
